rationale: Every material claim in the answer was checked against implementation, configuration, tests, CI, or documentation and verified. Key confirmations: HEAD e52106fd equals origin/develop (packed-refs); desktop declares both @marktext/muyajs (legacy) and @muyajs/core (current) at package.json:62-63; config.ts:12-19 and the context-isolation E2E spec confirm sandbox (contextIsolation/sandbox true, nodeIntegration false); window orchestration is spread across App._createEditorWindow (app/index.ts:477), WindowManager (windowManager.ts:85, which also owns the watcher), and BaseWindow (base.ts:15-20); the save path is raw positional IPC through menu/actions/file.ts:157, filesystem/markdown.ts:69 (encoding/EOL) and filesystem/index.ts:25-48 (write-file-atomic with fsync-then-rename); editor.ts is 2102 lines and editor.vue 2133 lines; muya-core.d.ts:45-51 keeps Muya as `any` and editor.vue:172-175 uses `type MuyaInstance = any`; ipc.ts:10-12 documents permissive `unknown` args while internalIpc.ts:4-12 forwards `ipcMain.emit` payloads (BrowserWindow included, e.g. watcher registration); files.ts:97-103 puts a function inside FileNotification; the update-buffer-state contract declares `ret: void` (ipc.ts:85) but the handler returns boolean (editorBufferStore/index.ts:187-198); fs.ts:40-77 and shell.ts:6-25 accept arbitrary paths/URLs with no main-side policy; test/build/lint/e2e workflows all paths-ignore packages/muya/**; ARCHITECTURE.md:12-15 and PARITY_SCOREBOARD.md:69 are stale in exactly the ways the answer describes; syntheticHistory.ts exists and converts Muya history shape into desktop dirty-tracking. The only claims I could not independently re-derive were five of the six commit subjects (no git CLI available) and the approximate git hit counts (~18/~36); c907b29c matches the visible history as the flush-before-save fix and the substantive invariants those commits supposedly encode are all present in current code, so this is a disclosure caveat, not a factual error. The answer correctly distinguishes the current engine (@muyajs/core) from the legacy platform (@marktext/muyajs) and does not treat the legacy engine as current. The three documentation-vs-implementation drifts it touches are all historical/resolved and none is decision-relevant, so the gate passes. All nine dimensions earn full credit: scope/confidence are stated from multiple signals, evidence is path/symbol-specific and separates current evidence from intent, friction explains spread and why it matters, quality attributes are ranked with trade-offs and verification, three viable options include the current shape, the recommendation follows from the evidence, migration is phased/reversible with exit conditions, verification is concrete (flush/encoding/atomic-write/watcher/contract-drift), and conditional heuristics (wait for a third window/second engine) are not smuggled into universal rules.
